nonAssetExclusions.justification: Repository documentation and crawler text are distributed as text, not as artistic assets.
Static HTML pages are application source documents. Embedded third-party marks are inventoried separately below.
Generated manifests, mappings, sitemap data, and web app metadata are evidence or packaging metadata rather than artistic assets.
Electron entitlement property lists are packaging policy, not artistic assets.
Layouts, adaptive icon descriptors, values, and file-provider declarations are Android packaging metadata. The two drawable vector artworks remain in scope.
Asset catalog Contents.json files describe packaging slots and are not independent artistic assets.

embeddedAssets.description: The game-icons.net SVG path set embedded in the UI icon registry.
Discord, Twitch, X, Kick, and YouTube marks embedded in the UI icon registry.
Third-party social platform marks embedded in the public links page.
The Discord mark embedded in the public support page.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: Kay Lousberg, Quaternius, Kenney, loafbrr, ambientCG, and Poly Haven

evidence.description: The asset credit table identifies the included source packs and their CC0 declarations.
The bundled Complete KayKit Collection v5 notice declares CC0 for the covered KayKit collection.
Build outputs connect the distributed biome files to named source packs.

rules.justification: Repository credits and build specs explicitly connect these outputs to packs declared CC0.
notes: Keep upstream pack notices and source archives with release records even where attribution is not required.

evidence.description: Credits identify all three water normal maps as three.js r165 example textures under MIT.
The pinned upstream release contains the MIT license notice.

rules.justification: The files have a pinned upstream version and an explicit MIT notice.
notes: Preserve the upstream MIT copyright and license notice in redistributions.

evidence.description: Credits identify the exact path, author, source page, and CC BY 4.0 requirement.
The upstream image page is the declared source reference.

rules.justification: The repository identifies the panorama under CC BY 4.0 with a precise source and author.
notes: Release notices must retain the author, source, and CC BY 4.0 reference.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: Tripo, Meshy, Mixamo, and disputed KayKit paid-pack sources

evidence.description: Credits declare several Meshy and Tripo sources but do not include account, plan, task, or transfer proof.
The character spec describes Adventurers 2.0 and Character Animations 1.1 as paid sources.
Source comments identify the quest objects as Meshy-generated.

rules.justification: The distributed files lack the account, plan, task, base-model, or exact paid-pack evidence needed to establish reusable rights for this fork.
notes: KayKit 2.0 evidence conflicts with CREDITS.md and License.txt, so no license is asserted until each file is tied to a specific covered archive.

evidence.description: Credits identify project-generated legacy weapons and procedural backdrops.
The generator documents the procedural construction of chicken_cow.glb.
History connects CombatMech, its chromas, and Fernando artwork to project commits without a reusable transfer document.

rules.justification: Project authorship is stated or technically evidenced, but no contract or fork-reuse grant is present.
notes: The Fernando likeness also requires documented consent and ownership of the source artwork.

evidence.description: Commit history and repository credits contain no reliable source or license for these paths.

rules.justification: No author, source pack, service, or license can be established from repository evidence.
notes: Do not infer a source from visual similarity or neighboring files.

evidence.description: Credits state that Levy Street purchased the premium icon packs through its own account.
The item mapping identifies the CraftPix default and the six project-art exceptions.
CraftPix publishes the applicable premium license terms.

rules.justification: The license was purchased by Levy Street and the repository contains no separate transferable grant to this fork.
notes: Replace before an independent CodexCraft release unless transferable rights are documented.

evidence.description: The Complete KayKit Collection v5 notice declares CC0.
The converter connects the weapon bit source pack to the distributed weapon images and models.

rules.justification: The converter and bundled pack notice connect these weapon images to a CC0 KayKit source.
notes: Archive the exact source pack with release evidence.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: World of ClaudeCraft project contributors and commissioned artists

evidence.description: Credits identify the bag art, commissioned deed art, and legacy weapon art as project assets.
The item mapping explicitly overrides six bags as World of ClaudeCraft original art.

rules.justification: The repository states project authorship or commission, but does not contain the contracts or fork-reuse grant.
notes: Obtain assignment, commission, or contributor records before reuse in an independent release.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: Tripo and OpenAI outputs produced for World of ClaudeCraft, plus disputed KayKit Adventurers 2.0 images

evidence.description: Credits connect the Armory renders to Tripo and the promo background to OpenAI image editing.
The character spec identifies the Adventurers 2.0 source as paid while other evidence is contradictory.

rules.justification: Account, plan, task, and source-pack proof is insufficient to establish reusable rights for these derived images.
notes: Replace or archive the complete generation and paid-pack evidence before release.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: World of ClaudeCraft renders of mixed-source models

evidence.description: The renderer ties the portraits to model assets whose provenance is not uniform.

rules.justification: A portrait can be cleared only after its underlying model and render ownership are both resolved.
notes: Do not inherit a global model license for these rendered derivatives.

evidence.description: Credits, mappings, source comments, and commit history do not establish a reliable source or license.

rules.justification: No precise license or provenance evidence exists for these distributed UI files.
notes: Treat each path as replaceable until a source record is attached.

evidence.description: The audio table identifies the quest and lockpick clips as CC0 original or CC0-derived work.

rules.justification: The repository explicitly declares these named audio families under CC0.
notes: Retain the source credit as useful provenance even though CC0 does not require attribution.

evidence.description: The deterministic FFmpeg generator proves the local synthesis method for this family.
Credits identify the ui_ clips as project-generated assets.

rules.justification: Generation is reproducible, but the repository has no explicit license or contributor grant for fork reuse.
notes: Archive authorship and contributor terms or regenerate an independently owned replacement set.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: ElevenLabs outputs produced for World of ClaudeCraft

evidence.description: The SFX generator uses ElevenLabs for the covered catalog.
The voice generator documents ElevenLabs production of NPC lines.

rules.justification: No account, plan, voice consent, generation ledger, or transferable output-rights proof is stored with the files.
notes: Voices require both service-plan evidence and any necessary performer or voice consent records.

evidence.description: Two cast clips are marked custom without a source or license record.
The procedural music code does not prove that the four distributed MP3 files were produced by that chain.

rules.justification: The exact sources and licenses of these audio files cannot be established from repository evidence.
notes: Do not infer provenance from filenames, adjacent generators, or runtime use.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: Natanael Gama, Juan Pablo del Peral, and Huerta Tipografica

evidence.description: Credits identify the font families, authors, Google Fonts sources, and SIL OFL 1.1.

rules.justification: All distributed WOFF2 files are tied to named OFL font families in CREDITS.md.
notes: Add and preserve the dedicated OFL notice files for the exact font versions and subsets.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: Higgsfield and Recraft outputs produced for World of ClaudeCraft

evidence.description: The asset set documents Higgsfield MCP and Recraft V4.1 generation plus local compositing.
Credits state paid-plan generation without account or transfer evidence.

rules.justification: The repository lacks paid-account, plan, prompt, job, and transferable output-rights proof.
notes: These World of ClaudeCraft currency visuals must also be replaced during rebranding.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: World of ClaudeCraft renders of mixed-source models

evidence.description: The renderer produces these stills from runtime model assets with mixed provenance statuses.

rules.justification: Each still inherits unresolved questions from its model and from the ownership of the render itself.
notes: Regenerate only after the corresponding replacement model is cleared.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: World of ClaudeCraft and Levy Street

evidence.description: The repository distinguishes World of ClaudeCraft brand assets from third-party art.
Desktop packaging declares the three build icons as product icons.
README and native packaging references identify the two root images and native resources as current brand visuals.

rules.justification: These files display or package the original World of ClaudeCraft identity and are outside the future CodexCraft brand set.
notes: Replacement is mandatory regardless of whether a future ownership document is found.

evidence.description: No precise source or license entry was found for these three public media files.

rules.justification: Repository evidence does not support a provenance or license claim for these backgrounds.
notes: They are visually tied to the current site but remain unknown rather than receiving an assumed project license.

evidence.description: The source comment names game-icons.net, Lorc, Delapouite, and CC BY 3.0.

rules.justification: The embedded vector paths carry an explicit CC BY 3.0 attribution requirement in source.
notes: Keep author, site, and license attribution with releases containing the inline paths.

rules.sourceOrAuthor: Discord, Twitch, X, Kick, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, and GitHub

evidence.description: The brand marks section separates platform trademarks from project art.
The UI icon registry labels the embedded platform marks as brand marks.

rules.justification: These are third-party identifiers, not project-owned artistic assets or code covered automatically by MIT.
notes: Review each platform's current brand guidelines before release and replace any mark that is no longer necessary.
